note: Canonical machine-readable record of what has met an instrument. The status tables in the READMEs are written for humans; this file is what a machine should read, and evidence/check.py verifies every claim in it against the tree. See evidence/README.md.

vocabulary.validated: ran on the physical instrument, with a person watching, and passed
vocabulary.written: the script exists and runs dry or sim-clean; it has never met the instrument
vocabulary.failed: ran on the physical instrument and did not pass
vocabulary.not_started: named as intended work; no script exists yet

hosts.starpi: Raspberry Pi wired to the liquid handler and the ODTC
hosts.starpi2: second Raspberry Pi; the Tecan Infinite lives here

operations.evidence: STAR bring-up with skip_autoload=True; channels and iSWAP homed, autoload skipped.
Single-column DRY motion coverage for the lysis and reaction additions, with the stage transfer geometry tuned against the physical deck.
caveats: Dry only. The wet single addition is written and has never run.
Transfer volumes, source mapping, and wet-run parameters are operator-owned inputs and are not recorded here.

caveats: Dry. A real thermal cycle inside the choreography has not run to completion.

operations.evidence: Five clean open/close cycles. Close is stable at 3.6 s on all five. Open is bimodal: 3.2 s from a settled stage, 5.3 s when a failed read has left the stage parked mid-scan.
caveats: Timing tracks the stage's start position, not the plate. Budget the 5.3 s worst case for an iSWAP handoff.

operations.evidence: Deterministic TimeoutError reading USB, 2 of 2, raised in driver.py run_scan on 'ABSOLUTE MTP,Y=<y_stage>'. setup() and the tray succeed in the same run, so the reader is talking and its drawer obeys; the Y-stage command is simply never answered. No wells, no OD matrix.
caveats: Distinct from the older 20-byte calibration-frame decode bug, which is a decode failure downstream of a scan that streams.
